# Table of Contents

# 1\. Executive Summary

This document defines Module 06 - Reports & Analytics for the AMR Coordinator Portal (iPOMS). It consolidates the stakeholder discussion covering live analytics, the report library, and the Report Builder into a single functional specification.

Module 06 is the Business Intelligence and Report Automation Center of iPOMS - the module that converts operational data captured across Daily Tracker (Module 03), Weekly Tracker (Module 04), and Daily Leads (Module 05) into live insights and polished, branded reports for both internal review and external sharing with college management.

# 2\. Purpose

Reports & Analytics exists to remove the team's dependency on manual tools such as Canva and Excel for weekly and monthly reporting, while giving Placement Coordinators, Team Leaders, and Administrators a live, interactive view of operational performance.

The module serves two distinct audiences: internal stakeholders who analyze trends and make decisions, and college management, who receive polished exported reports rather than direct system access.

# 3\. Module Philosophy

The module follows three simple principles.

## 3.1 Analyze

Help users understand operational performance - for example, how many companies were contacted, which coordinator performed best, which college is progressing well, and which companies have gone quiet.

## 3.2 Generate

Automatically create professional reports from live system data. No manual Canva work, no copy-paste, no Excel formatting.

## 3.3 Share

Allow users to export reports in professional formats - PDF, Excel, PNG - and share them with college management or internally.

# 4\. Who Can Access This Module

| **Role**                               | **Access**                                               |
| -------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| Placement Coordinator                  | Yes                                                      |
| Team Leader                            | Yes                                                      |
| Administrator                          | Yes                                                      |
| Training & Placement Officer (College) | No - receives exported reports, not direct system access |

All three internal roles use the module; reports are prepared primarily for college management and internal review.

# 5\. Data Sources

The module holds no operational data of its own - it reads and consolidates information already captured elsewhere in iPOMS.

| **Source Module**          | **Provides**                                                               |
| -------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| User Management            | Coordinator names, Team Leader names, assigned colleges                    |
| Master Company Database    | Company details, HR details, company categories                            |
| Daily Tracker (Module 03)  | Calls, follow-ups, daily activities, call outcomes                         |
| Weekly Tracker (Module 04) | Completed, In Progress, Pipeline, and Rejected companies; follow-up status |
| Daily Leads (Module 05)    | Positive responses, JD received, company opportunities                     |

Everything shown in Reports & Analytics is derived from these modules - nothing is re-typed or re-keyed.

# 6\. Module Structure Overview

Reports & Analytics is organized into three sections:

- Analytics - interactive exploration of live data; never exported as a document.
- Reports - a library of the four finalized report templates.
- Report Builder - generates a branded, editable report from live data on demand.

# 7\. Section 1 - Analytics

## 7.1 Purpose

Interactive business analysis. This section is not used for exports; it helps users understand trends and performance in real time.

## 7.2 KPI Cards

- Total Calls
- Positive Responses
- Companies Contacted
- Active Colleges
- JD Received
- Follow-ups Completed

## 7.3 Comparisons

- Weekly Comparison - this week vs last week.
- Monthly Comparison - current month vs previous month.
- Coordinator Comparison - Coordinator A vs Coordinator B.
- College Comparison - College A vs College B.

## 7.4 Company Analytics

A dedicated Company Report was considered and rejected (see Section 8.2.2); this information lives here instead, as live analytics rather than an exportable document:

- Most Responsive Company
- Least Responsive Company
- Companies Awaiting Follow-up
- Highest Package Companies
- Top Recruiting Companies
- Companies by Industry

## 7.5 Insights Panel

Rather than showing only numbers, the system automatically generates meaningful observations across four categories:

- Coordinator Insights - e.g. highest call completion this week, best follow-up completion.
- Company Insights - e.g. pending follow-up for 12 days, most responsive company.
- College Insights - e.g. most active college, highest number of interviews or offers.
- Trend Insights - e.g. call volume increased 18%, positive responses improved 10%.

This lets a user understand the data at a glance, without interpreting every chart individually.

# 8\. Section 2 - Reports (Report Library)

## 8.1 Purpose

A dedicated place to view and generate the finalized report templates - a report library, not a design surface.

## 8.2 Rejected Report Categories

Several additional report types were discussed and deliberately excluded from Version 1.0, to avoid duplicating information already available elsewhere:

- Daily Report - rejected; already covered by the Dashboard's daily monitoring view.
- Company Report - rejected; company-level information already appears in the Weekly, Monthly, and Coordinator reports, and in Company Analytics (Section 7.4).
- Placement Pipeline Report - rejected; already covered by the Weekly Tracker.
- Lead Conversion Report - rejected; better shown as KPI cards in the Admin Dashboard and in Analytics.
- Custom Reports - deferred; can be introduced later if a genuine need arises.

## 8.3 Final Design - Four Report Templates

Instead of eight to ten overlapping reports, Module 06 ships with exactly four, each built to be more useful on its own:

| **Report Type**                    | **Audience**                      | **Key Contents**                                                                                                                                    |
| ---------------------------------- | --------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 1\. Weekly Placement Report        | College Management, Internal Team | Completed Companies, In Progress, Pipeline, Follow-up Summary, Insights, Logos, Generated By/Date                                                   |
| 2\. Monthly Placement Report       | Management Review                 | Monthly KPIs, Company/College/Coordinator Summary, Comparison vs previous month, Charts, Insights                                                   |
| 3\. College Performance Report     | One specific college              | Companies Contacted, Positive Responses, Drives Conducted, Offers Received, Highest/Average Package, Assigned Coordinator, Insights                 |
| 4\. Coordinator Performance Report | Internal management               | Colleges Handled, Companies Contacted, Calls Completed, Positive Responses, JD Received, Drives Conducted, Performance Summary (no ranking in v1.0) |

# 9\. Section 3 - Report Builder

## 9.1 Purpose

The core feature of Module 06: it generates a professional report from live data through one guided wizard - no Canva, no manual copy-paste.

## 9.2 Workflow Overview

A user builds a report in this sequence:

- Select Report Type.
- Choose Filters.
- Branding loads automatically.
- Choose which sections to include.
- Generate a live preview.
- Refine it in the Report Editor.
- Export and, optionally, share.

## 9.3 Step 1 - Select Report Type

Weekly, Monthly, College, or Coordinator - the four templates defined in Section 8.3.

## 9.4 Step 2 - Choose Filters

Depending on the report type: College, Coordinator, Week, Month, Year.

## 9.5 Step 3 - Branding

The Infoziant logo and the relevant college logo load automatically - each college profile stores its logo once, so nothing is uploaded manually every week.

## 9.6 Step 4 - Choose Sections

Users include or exclude sections depending on the audience, for example:

- KPI Summary
- Completed Companies
- In Progress
- Pipeline
- Charts
- Insights
- Remarks

## 9.7 Step 5 - Generate Preview

The system composes the report automatically, reading live data directly from the Weekly Tracker, Daily Tracker, and Daily Leads - for example, Completed Companies in the Weekly Tracker becomes "Companies Completed" in the report, without the coordinator typing anything again.

## 9.8 Step 6 - Report Editor

Detailed in Section 10.

## 9.9 Step 7 - Export

Detailed in Section 13.

# 10\. Report Editor - Design & Capabilities

This was the most-debated design decision for Module 06, and went through three options before a final direction was chosen.

## 10.1 Rejected Approach - Simple Preview Only

The first option considered: generate the report, then allow only a title change, remarks, section show/hide, and a logo change, before export. This was rejected - the underlying weekly reports change too frequently for such a rigid editor to stay useful.

## 10.2 Rejected Approach - Canva as the Primary Editor

Embedding Canva as the core editing surface was also considered. This was rejected: Canva's developer tools are not designed to embed its full editor inside another application, and relying on it as the primary editor would make iPOMS dependent on an external platform for a core workflow.

## 10.3 Final Design - Native Report Editor

iPOMS will ship its own lightweight, document-editor-style surface - comparable in spirit to Google Docs, Notion, or Airtable - where every section of a generated report becomes directly editable:

- Editable table cells - click a cell, type, press Enter.
- Rename column headers in place.
- Insert or delete columns.
- Add, edit, or remove remarks.
- Drag sections into a different order (e.g. move Pipeline before Completed).
- Change the report theme - Blue, Green, Purple, Company Theme, or College Theme.

## 10.4 Live Page Indicator

The editor displays the report as real, numbered pages (Page 1, Page 2, …) rather than one continuous scroll. As the user edits, pages reflow automatically, so the exported PDF always matches exactly what is on screen - no surprise page breaks.

## 10.5 Deferred - Canva Hand-off

Not part of Version 1.0: an optional "Open in Canva" hand-off after export, to be evaluated once Canva's available integration options are reviewed further.

# 11\. Branding Rules

Every generated report automatically includes:

- Infoziant Logo
- College Logo (loaded from the college's saved profile)
- Report Title
- Report Period
- Generated By
- Generated Date
- Confidential Footer
- Consistent colors and typography drawn from the selected theme

Users are never required to manually add any branding element.

# 12. Report Storage, Builder Configuration & Save Rules

To distinguish report configurations from ephemeral exports per `V1_DECISIONS.md`:

1. **Report Builder Configuration (Saved):** Saved in the `report_library` collection. Stores template definitions, filter presets (college, dates, coordinators), customized column selections, and branding options so users do not re-configure from scratch every week.
2. **Generated Report Presentation (In-Memory / Editable):** When a user clicks *Generate Report*, the raw data is aggregated live from `weekly_tracker`, `daily_tracker`, and `daily_leads`. The report is displayed in the native interactive Report Editor where coordinators can edit table cells, update column labels, re-order sections, and add contextual remarks before finalizing.
3. **Download / Local Storage:** When finalized, the report is exported directly to the user's local machine in their chosen format (**PDF**, **Excel**, or **PNG**). iPOMS does not store heavy binary document files in MongoDB.
4. **Audit Logging (Permanent):** Every report generation automatically creates an entry in `audit_logs` recording: `user_id`, `template_name`, `college_id`, `filters_applied`, `timestamp`, and `request_id`.

---

# 13. Export & Sharing Options (Unified Formats)

Every one of the 4 approved report templates supports **all 3 primary export formats**:

- **PDF:** Polished, vector-rendered multi-page document with automatic page breaking and confidential headers/footers.
- **Excel (.xlsx):** Multi-tab structured workbook with formatted headers and auto-filtered data rows.
- **PNG (High-Resolution Image Snapshot):** Branded card layout optimized for crisp previewing and direct sharing via WhatsApp or MS Teams.

---

# 14. Report Quality Checklist

Before export, the Report Editor displays a short checklist confirming the report is complete and presentation-ready:

- College logo available & verified
- Infoziant branding header present
- Report title & period selected
- Generated By & Generated Date stamped
- Performance insights & coordinator remarks included
- Table figures verified

---

# 15. Native Report Editing Rules

The Report Editor is designed for presentation refinement and management polishing:

- **Editable Presentation Elements:** Headings, column titles, custom remarks, cell values for presentation formatting, section order, and visual color themes (Blue, Green, Purple, College Branded).
- **Non-Destructive Guarantee:** Editing a generated report **NEVER** mutates or overwrites the underlying operational records in the primary database collections (`daily_tracker`, `weekly_tracker`, `daily_leads`, `company_metadata`).

---

# 16. Insights Rules

Insights are generated automatically from system data across four categories: Coordinator Insights, Company Insights, College Insights, and Trend Insights.

- Users may add their own remarks or comments alongside an insight.
- Users cannot change how the system calculates an insight.

---

# 17. Role-Based Permission Matrix

| Feature / Action | Coordinator | Team Leader | Administrator | TPO (College) |
|---|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|
| View Live Analytics (KPIs, comparisons, insights) | ✅ (Assigned) | ✅ (All/Team) | ✅ (System) | ❌ |
| Generate a report via Report Builder | ✅ (Assigned) | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ |
| Edit a generated report in Report Editor | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ |
| Export a report (PDF / Excel / PNG) | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ (Weekly Placement) |
| Save custom Report Builder presets to `report_library` | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ |
| Modify report branding defaults (theme, footer text) | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ | ❌ |

---

# 18. Integration With Other Modules

- **User Management (Module 01):** Supplies coordinator and team leader details and college assignment boundaries.
- **Master Company Database (Module 02):** Supplies corporate details and verified hiring metadata.
- **Daily Tracker (Module 03):** Supplies daily call activities and conversion rates.
- **Weekly Tracker (Module 04):** Supplies the 7-section placement pipeline groupings that feed the Weekly Placement Report.
- **Daily Leads (Module 05):** Supplies positive responses and JD-received metrics.

---

# 19. Business Rules Summary

- Reports & Analytics reads data dynamically from operational collections; it maintains saved configurations in `report_library`.
- The Analytics section is live interactive BI and is distinct from exportable documents.
- Four standardized report templates: Weekly Placement, Monthly Placement, College Performance, Coordinator Performance.
- A generated report is interactive and editable before download; editing never modifies source records.
- Unified exports support **PDF, Excel, and PNG** across all report templates.
- Every generation event is permanently recorded in `audit_logs`.
- TPOs have read-only access strictly to their institution's finalized Weekly Placement Report.

---

# 20. Deferred / Out of Scope for v1.0

- Dedicated standalone company reports (superseded by Company Analytics and standard templates).
- Competitive coordinator rankings or public leaderboards in v1.0.
- Heavy raw binary PDF/XLSX file storage in MongoDB.
- External Canva embedded frame (native interactive editor provided instead).

---

# 21. Conclusion
Module 06 provides comprehensive operational BI and native report generation with multi-format exports (PDF, Excel, PNG) and seamless audit logging per `V1_DECISIONS.md`.

# 22\. Next Steps

Modules 03 (Daily Tracker), 04 (Weekly Tracker), 05 (Daily Leads), and 06 (Reports & Analytics) now form a complete operational-to-reporting chain. Further documentation - such as Administration & Settings, or platform-wide non-functional requirements - can be scoped next at the CEO's direction.
